provider.name: Global Names
provider.organization_type: scientific-name parsing, recognition, verification, resolution, reconciliation, indexing, canonicalization, matching, and biodiversity nomenclature infrastructure
provider.description: Global Names develops infrastructure for finding, parsing, normalizing, matching, verifying, and reconciling scientific names. Its software and services include name parsers, verifiers, indexes, text name-finders, matchers, resolvers, APIs, and data-source integrations.
institutional_context: Global Names project and open-source community
Biodiversity informatics and taxonomic data-source providers
Natural history museums, taxonomic databases, publishers, and research institutions
Scientific nomenclature and name-reconciliation software ecosystem

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting Global Names documentation, name parsing and verification guidance, resolver and index services, source repositories, APIs, data models, matching methods, source provenance, licenses, citations, deployment, manuals, tutorials, and service-status information.
purpose.authoritative_notice: Global Names project documentation, service APIs, source repositories, software releases, and integrated source providers remain authoritative for algorithms, schemas, source IDs, matches, licensing, and operational behavior.
